chunks.text: The second quarter closed with revenue 27 percent above the same quarter last year.
Operating costs rose 9 percent, the team did not open a second office, and headcount remained at 18 people.
The studio plans to review hiring needs again in October.
No decision has been made about expanding into a new region.

queries.claim: Revenue increased by 27 percent in the second quarter.
Hiring needs will be reviewed in October.
A new region has not yet been approved.
